notes: Every bubble on the cloud home is one circle now, and its icon, number and label sit in a column inside it instead of stacked on top of each other.
The tabs are icons and only icons: five equal tiles lifted along a curve, one glyph each, the plus at the top. The split treads keep both taps but paint one icon.
Lyrics is back in the mini bar, as an icon beside the controls.
Albums and Playlists stop reserving a band of empty theme colour under the list - the views keep the bar and a breath, and the flight floats over the corner.
It moves smoother: the bubbles no longer float in a loop and the tabs drop their per-tile blur, so scrolling the list under them stops paying for both.
Every bubble keeps its resize chip, its Ask sparkle, its play button and its three header buttons on the rim, clear of the reading.
